name: gold
durability: Durable for everyday jewelry; higher-karat gold is softer.
care: Clean with mild soap and a soft cloth; avoid harsh chemicals.

name: sterling silver
durability: Suitable for everyday jewelry but can scratch and tarnish.
care: Store dry and polish with a silver cloth.

name: ceramic
durability: Scratch-resistant but may chip if struck or dropped.
care: Wipe with a damp soft cloth and protect from hard impacts.

name: pearl
durability: Delicate organic gemstone that can scratch easily.
care: Keep away from perfume and chemicals; wipe after wearing.

name: platinum
durability: Dense, durable, and well suited to long-term wear.
care: Clean with mild soap; professional polishing removes patina.
